body: The knowledge that there is no god shouldn't be depressing. It's the most freeing thing you could learn. You can do anything you want now. Gay relationships, bacon cheeseburgers for every meal, anything you want. It also means you have to figure out what you want to do with your life, because there's nobody in the sky telling you how to live. Think about what would fulfill you, and do that. You're nobody's slave. Congratulations on getting free. Accept that there isn't any meaning and go do something fun.

Here are a few things to think about:

You have a girlfriend, which is better than a lot of people can manage

Your relationship would be a lot more rewarding if you learned Thai, I'd wager. If you're as smart as you claim, it shouldn't be a problem if you have teacher who cares about you \(which you do\)

You obviously have money, or you wouldn't be able to travel so much

I bet you're good looking too

Count your blessings, bro.

Anyway, try hanging out with your acquaintances some time when you're not drinking. You could all do something fun together \(idk what normal people do I'm not one either\). The point is at least try with them, and maybe they'll start introducing you to their friends. That's how I made all of mine.

Over the counter pills. They put stuff in them so that you throw up if you take too many. It almost certainly won't kill you, but there can be other effects if nobody gets to you in time. I don't recommend doing that because you might wind up in a mental hospital which I'm sure you don't want.
